_comment: R58.2 (2026-09-03): Phase 1.3 hardware preset for RTX 50xx 32GB VRAM (RTX 5090). NEWEST arch (sm_120, Blackwell). Requires CUDA 12.8+ and image rebuild — bundled sm_86 image WON'T work.

_hardware.name: RTX 50xx 32GB
_hardware._rebuild_required_note: sm_120 (Blackwell) requires CUDA 12.8+ and image rebuild. Set CUDA_ARCH=120 and rebuild cppworker image with tag like 120-abort-r35.

_model_recommendations._comment: At 32GB, full GPU offload works for 7B-30B (Q4_K_M). 70B fits with partial offload (fast).
_model_recommendations._recommendation: 32GB enables 70B Q4 with full KV cache. RTX 5090 is fastest single-GPU card as of 2026.

docker._tag_note: You need to BUILD the cppworker image with this tag (no upstream image yet). Use docker compose build with CUDA_ARCH=120.

cppworker._ctx_note: 32GB enables 65K context for most 13B models without OOM
cppworker._batch_note: Bigger batch = better throughput on RTX 5090 (more SMs, more VRAM bandwidth)

balancer._comment: RTX 5090 is fast — short first-byte timeouts, large n_ctx allowed.
